section_title: What independent review actually looks like

cards.label: Real objections
cards.headline: Reviewers object, and it's recorded
cards.body: Verdicts, objections and revisions are stored as a queryable decision trail, not a rubber stamp.

cards.label: A real catch
cards.headline: It caught a production-risk defect before it shipped
cards.body: A code review by the council flagged an unguarded call that could have aborted a production sweep.

cards.label: Self-correcting
cards.headline: It reviews us, too
cards.body: When a change was wrongly marked as approved, the correction went into the record by name.

cards.label: Every change
cards.headline: Platform changes go through the gate
cards.body: The same review process that checks client work checks the platform's own code.
